{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the status column for completeness and values
print("Unique values in 'status' column:")
print(data['status'].unique())

# Count how many orders have status 'completed'
completed_count = (data['status'] == 'completed').sum()

# Print the result
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_count}")"}
